required_findings.criteria: Identifies that combining unrelated buttons removes independently discoverable actions and recommends separate controls.
Identifies that status is communicated only by color and requires a textual, symbolic, or semantic alternative.
Identifies the Dynamic Type range cap as preventing supported larger accessibility sizes.
Identifies repeated programmatic accessibility focus movement as disruptive and recommends event-scoped focus changes.
States that native modifiers do not repair web content and requires a separate web accessibility and focus-transition audit.

forbidden_claims: Claims exact VoiceOver speech without device evidence
Claims the native modifier repairs inaccessible web content
